summary: Iteration 5 (Turn10) full regression. Backend: 47/47 pytest PASS including 3 new TestIter5Elo tests: (a) elo.NEW_PLAYER_MATCHES == 20 constant; (b) Elo FLOOR — created a 4-player match where the highest-rated test player finished 2nd behind the lowest-rated player and asserted their elo_base_delta >= 0, while the last-placed player still had elo_base_delta < 0 (test also auto-primes a boost match if all seeded ratings are equal); (c) new player (matches_played < 20) has clearly larger |elo_base_delta| than an established player (matches_played >= 20) in the same match (K_NEW=60 vs K_ESTABLISHED=20). Frontend (mobile 430x900, admin login): (1) History page — every visible match row shows a comma-separated list of participant names under the winner's name (verified 5/5 rows via [data-testid^='match-card-'] + '.text-[11px]' selector, e.g. 'Kungen, Jocke, Ankan'). (2) Ny match STEP 2 — each rule-card-toggle shows the rule name AND a short description under it (e.g. 'Tvåan nollställer' / 'Tian vänder' / 'Chansa'); tapping the info icon (rule-info-{id}) opens a bottom sheet showing the category + full description ('En 2:a nollställer högen – nästa spelare får lägga valfritt kort.' etc.) and closes via close-rule-info; tapping the card body toggles the active check icon on/off independently. (3) Ny match STEP 3 — 3 drag-handle-{id} handles and 3 placement-row-{id} rows rendered, NO move-up-* / move-down-* buttons anywhere; only N-1=2 exit-card-picker-button-* rendered and the last row shows the 'kom sist' label with no picker. Dragging handle[0] downward with a PointerEvent sequence (pointerdown → 9 pointermove steps with 70ms waits → pointerup) reordered the array from [uid_A, uid_B, uid_C] to [uid_B, uid_C, uid_A]; the Crown icon moved to the new first row. Save via submit-match-results-button lands on /match/:id ('Match sparad!' toast) and the resulting match detail shows the dragged order as final placements, base rules panel below. (4) LIVE Elo floor confirmation on the saved match: Kungen (rating 1293) placed 2nd behind Tommy (rating 1110) → elo_delta shown as 0 (floored), while Jocke (3rd, lower half, rating 1018) got -3 — matches iter-5 spec. (5) Regression: admin login OK, public /topplista loads without auth, register still requires invite 267710, exit_bonus math (v3=+5, v2/v10=+0, v5=+4, v14=0, v8=+3) preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: NewMatch.jsx onRowMove/onRowUp read dragUid from state; because pointer capture on the drag-handle keeps events on the source element this works, but a defensive ref (like RoundTable already has) would be safer against React batching. Worked reliably in Playwright with 70ms/move waits.
server.py still 865+ lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/matches/rules/awards) for maintainability.

Elo floor implementation in compute_match_elo uses `math.ceil(n/2)` which correctly treats placement<=2 as upper half in a 4-player match; verified live: 2nd-place high-rated player got 0 instead of negative, last-place still negative.
In NewMatch.jsx the rule card description uses `line-clamp-2` at text-[8px] on mobile — legible but tiny; consider text-[9px] for improved accessibility (nice-to-have).
History row participant list uses `truncate` which cuts off names on long matches (5-6 players); acceptable on mobile but a tooltip/expand would be nicer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter-5 review flows verified (rule descriptions, info sheet, drag reorder, no arrows, kom sist, save, history participant names, live floor evidence)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now has 47 tests (added TestIter5Elo class with 3 tests). Elo floor is tested by dynamically boosting the highest test player's rating if ratings are equal, then arranging a match where the higher-rated player is placed 2nd behind the lower-rated winner. Frontend drag reorder in NewMatch STEP 3 requires PointerEvent dispatch on drag-handle-{id} with waits between events (pointerdown -> 8-9 pointermove -> pointerup, ~70ms between each) — dispatching all in one tick causes React to miss the state update. History page uses `data-testid=match-card-{id}` (not <a> tag). Info sheet uses close-rule-info testid. All iter-5 routes verified.
